subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Federated Learning
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Federated Learning.

hook.text: Your phone helps train AI without your data ever leaving the device. The model learns locally, not centrally.

buildup.text: Federated learning trains AI models across many devices while keeping training data on each user's device.

discovery.text: Google uses federated learning for keyboard predictions — your typing improves the model without leaving your phone.

twist.text: Even model updates can leak information. Researchers have shown that gradients can sometimes reveal training data.

climax.text: Federated learning is a step toward privacy. But it's not a complete solution — every method has edge cases.

punchline.text: Train the AI. Keep your data. Almost perfect.

quiz.question: What makes federated learning more private than traditional AI training?
options: Training data stays on each user's device instead of being sent to a central server
It only works with anonymized data
